<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Nothing checks that the project docs stay valid: #110 and the s02 work edit PRD 001 and roadmap 001 with ddocs, and a broken link or a hand-edited .dd.md would only be found by the next person who runs ddocs. This plan adds `just ddocs-check` (harness/scripts/ddocs-check.ts): every .dd.json under docs/project/ and skills/pij/references/community/ must pass `ddocs validate` with 0 errors and 0 warnings and `ddocs build --check`. ddocs is found by ruling C10 (PIJ_DDOCS, else PATH). Without it the sensor never passes: it fails as UNAVAILABLE, or in CI warns UNAVAILABLE on every run.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A broken link, a schema error or a stale .dd.md in docs/project/ or the skill examples fails the done gate.
- The sensor never passes when it validated nothing: no ddocs, or no documents, is a named non-pass.
- Local gate and CI run the same command.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Publishing ddocs or adding it as a dependency (it is not on an allowed registry yet).
- Validating docs/plans/ or .dd/ fixtures (plans have their own `harness plan validate`; the role fixtures include documents that must fail).
